entries.text: Hi Ross — I'm Sarah, an AI researcher with HeliumDeploy. Thank you so much for taking 15 minutes to do this — it really means a lot. Honestly, the more you can share with me, the better — we're aiming for about a thousand words of feedback together, so please don't worry about going long. The founders read every word of these chats, so what you say actually shapes what HD does next. As a thank-you you'll get a $75 discount code at the end. So — to kick us off, what brought you to HD recently?
Got it — looking at new products. Was there a specific one that pulled you in this time, or were you just browsing the catalog?
Little of both browsing the catalog and looking at, uh, looking at uh, the pin hardware. As well as, uh, seeing what you have for hammer miners.

Nice — DePIN hardware and Hammer miners. Let me pull up what you were looking at. I see you grabbed a Wingbits WB200 back in April, and you've been circling the Geodnet MobileCM since then — even started checkout on it. What's going on with that one?
Uh, just waiting, um, waiting to, uh, have some cash to check out with.
Got it — just a cashflow timing thing. So the decision is basically made, you're just waiting on funds?
Makes sense. Let me pull up the Geodnet — So you're already running Wingbits — what made you want to add Geodnet to the mix instead of, say, another WB200 or stacking more of the same network?

Well, um, uh, I don't have a Geodonet yet. And, uh, I didn't purchase the dual one earlier. Because of cost. I don't know. I don't I don't uh, know if you can, uh, run multiple, uh, units in one grid square either for that matter. Um, it's my understanding if you have, uh, wing bits in a grid square that uh, you're only allowed the one. You can't have two. If you can have two, whether it be GeoNet or Wingbits, that, uh, the information, uh, on the whim website needs to be clear on that.

That's super useful feedback — the "one per grid square" rule isn't clear on the site, and you're having to guess. Did you end up asking somewhere to figure that out, or are you still kind of in the dark on it?

Still a bit on the dark on it, but in, uh, working with the wing bits itself, uh, it I get the impression, uh, that if I were to deploy another one within my grid that I couldn't deploy it because I already have one. So, um, yeah, again, not really clear on that. But that's what it that's the impression I'm getting off of the information I'm reading.

Got it — so you're basically inferring it from the Wingbits dashboard rather than from anything HD or Wingbits explicitly told you. That's a real gap.

So if I'm hearing you right — the reason you're leaning Geodnet next is partly that you've maxed out what you can do with Wingbits in your area, and a second network lets you keep stacking in the same location. Is that the thinking?
That makes a lot of sense. Let me ask about this page — Have you looked at the Mining Rewards Estimate section on these product pages? What do you make of it?
